coverage: All three authored chapters, all displays and proofs, all seven figure captions, all labels, all citations, and exact source contracts used in these chapters.
routine_edits: Corrected the two descriptions of H-orbits Hg from left cosets to right cosets. Their group action is still left multiplication.
Added the precise Milne absolute Galois citations independently checked by the proof auditor.

Clarified split-lift continuity: rho is continuous by hypothesis, while the section s is continuous between finite discrete groups. All equations and the requirement that arithmetic lifts be continuous are unchanged.
Inserted only two page-flow commands: Needspace before section 4.3 and FloatBarrier before section 6.4. Mathematical text is byte-for-byte preserved after removing the inserted command lines.
Root inserted a contents-only newpage command immediately before chapter 5. Removing that command reproduces the previous frozen source hash, verifying that mathematical text is unchanged.
local_consistency_checks: Regular module action and group algebra injectivity declared before reverse implications.
Coset convention Hg corrected to right cosets under left action.
Average range, rank, subgroup order reversal, uniform multiplicity, support criterion, and quotient faithfulness proved.
S3 matrices in figure basis e,(12),(23),(13),(123),(132) checked against pairings.
S4 faithful group representation caveat proved with a vanishing subgroup average.
Normal basis map stated as a module isomorphism, with transported field multiplication distinct from group algebra multiplication.
Field trace normalized by group order, norm nonlinear, tower order matches reversed subgroup chain.
Hilbert specialization over Q uses full primitive degree and excluded model locus. Suitable parameter values are distinguished from distinct field isomorphism classes.
Generic x^3-t splitting field proved nonregular because it contains zeta3. t=0,1,2 groups classified with exact arguments.
Embedding problem maps are continuous into finite discrete targets. Weak lift, proper lift, and kernel coverage criterion are distinct.
Finite C2/C4 obstruction has finite domain and is not an absolute Galois counterexample.
Central correction equation has the sign fixed by direct multiplication, and continuity is checked separately.
source_dependencies: Milne2022 LC09, LC11, LC12, LC13, and auditor-checked Proposition 7.7 / Theorem 7.13

failures_and_resolutions.failure: Initial coset terminology called Hg a left coset.
failures_and_resolutions.cause: Confused the direction of the action with the conventional coset name.
failures_and_resolutions.resolution: Independent auditor identified the terminology slip. Both occurrences were corrected to right cosets without changing formulas, and the guide author was notified.

failures_and_resolutions.failure: First patch adding the absolute Galois citation failed verification.
failures_and_resolutions.cause: The patch searched for a sentence as a full line, but the actual line also began with the preceding phrase about the Krull topology.
failures_and_resolutions.resolution: Read the exact local source and reapplied the patch with the full line. It succeeded.

failures_and_resolutions.failure: Split-lift prose incorrectly described rho as a finite group map, although its domain is the profinite absolute Galois group.
failures_and_resolutions.cause: Compressed the two different reasons for continuity into one inaccurate phrase.
failures_and_resolutions.resolution: Independent second audit identified the wording. Replaced it by the exact reason for each map, and reran the isolated build.

proof_audit_boundary: The independent proof auditor checked all arguments. This record is conservative source self-review and local syntax validation, not a Lean certification or an unrestricted inverse Galois proof.
